newsitem.title: FINLAND: UPM-KYMMENE JAN-JUNE PROFIT ROSE - PAPER.
newsitem.headline: UPM-KYMMENE JAN-JUNE PROFIT ROSE - PAPER.

text.p: Finland largest forest industry group UPM-Kymmene's first half profit before extraordinary items rose to 3.525 billion markka from 2.076 billion markka in the year-ago period, daily Helsingin Sanomat reported on Thursday.
A UPM spokesman declined to comment and noted that UPM's first half interim report is due for release at 0800/0500 GMT.
The paper said UPM's first half net sales rose to 26.420 billion markka from 26.172 billion and the operating profit rose to 4.429 billion from 3.189 billion markka.
